stem: A sensor is giving an unexpected value. The site procedure says Technician I may verify placement and compare with an approved reference device but may not recalibrate it. What should the technician do?
choices: Complete the permitted verification checks, document results, and escalate recalibration if needed
Change the calibration until the reading looks normal
Ignore the value because sensors often drift
rationale: Operator-level verification should follow the assigned procedure and stop before unauthorized calibration or replacement.
